lambda_boundary: RELAY_PARAMETER_PHASE_CLASS_BOUNDARY: lambda in {0,-1,-2} selects a finite current phase hit; all other lambda never hits
large_integer_boundary: NO_ORDERED_INTEGER_BOUNDARY for phase-support magnitude M; M*e_p maps to either ZERO or unit e_sigma(p) independent of M magnitude
N_boundary: NO_INTRINSIC_N_BOUNDARY; min(N,B) saturation at small N is finite-object exhaustion
ordinary_numeric_lambda_boundary: NO_ORDERED_NUMERIC_BOUNDARY; signed magnitude ordering is PARAMETERIZATION_ARTIFACT
